text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Olive green long sleeve shirt with pale beige pointed collar and turned cuffs, black wide-leg trousers, black loafers.. Add ONLY these accessories: A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A large black woven leather tote handbag with two short handles.; A pair of black leather gloves, both complete, arranged side by side.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Create ONE complete photorealistic hollow wardrobe outfit on a pure white background, portrait 2:3, soft studio light. FIRST reference is the exact clothing base; preserve its cuts, colors, layers and footwear. Other references are individual accessory products belonging to this look. Garments: Olive green long sleeve shirt with pale beige pointed collar and turned cuffs, black wide-leg trousers, black loafers.. Add EXACTLY these accessories and no others: A fine silver chain necklace with tiny pendant, complete closed chain loop.; A silver trouser key chain with hook, short linked chain, key-shaped metal charms and a narrow brown leather tassel, shown detached as one accessory.; A large black woven leather tote handbag with two short handles.; A pair of black leather gloves, both complete, arranged side by side.. Arrange as a single cohesive empty outfit: tie at collar, belt at waist, scarf draped naturally, hat/eyewear hovering above empty neck if present, necklace around empty collar; bag beside hip with full strap. Watches, gloves or small jewelry can be placed neatly beside outfit, each once. No visible person, body, face, skin, hands, legs, mannequin, stand or hanger. Empty neck and sleeves. Preserve fully visible garments, shoes, accessory shapes, full chains and straps within frame. No source photos, collages, labels, text, props or watermark.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
